svg.text: Algorithm map: what to write in interviews, what to skim, what to master for contests

Green = interview core, write it right and fast; grey = skim, know what it solves and when to reach for it; blue = main line of the contest focus, top to bottom; yellow = side branch, picked up when the main line reaches its arrow.
Blue labels = notes already on this site: NT = Number Theory, C = Combinatorics, M = Matrix. Prerequisites across lanes are in the box details.
Interview core: write it right and fast (HFT / tech interviews, easy contest problems)
Skim: what it solves, what it costs, when to reach for it
Contest focus: mathematics. Derive the formula and state the idea under contest pressure
